entry.title: Hello, and welcome
entry.content:
Welcome! This is my corner of the web. I’m Haolin (Jayden) Xie — a Computer Science student at UC San Diego who likes building things at the intersection of full-stack development, application security, and applied AI.

I’ll use this space now and then to write about projects I’m working on and things I’m learning. In the meantime, take a look at my projects or CV.
entry.summary: A quick note on what this site is and what I'm working on.
